build.buildCommand: npm run build && mkdir -p .medusa/server/src && cp -r src/data .medusa/server/src/ && cd .medusa/server && npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund

preDeployCommand: cd .medusa/server && npx medusa db:migrate && npx medusa exec ./src/scripts/backfill-prices.js && npx medusa exec ./src/scripts/ensure-shipping-options.js && npx medusa exec ./src/scripts/setup-storefront-key.js
